symptom: The v10 plain-own-property checks accept a Date metrics object with numeric enumerable fields or an inherited toJSON method on the record/metrics. Canonical hashing ignores the exotic prototype while atomicWriteJson uses JSON.stringify, producing a different persisted payload. A changed candidate can be misclassified IDEMPOTENT_NOOP.
lesson: Own enumerable data properties alone do not guarantee JSON.stringify equivalence. Inherited toJSON and exotic internal slots can alter persisted bytes without altering the canonical digest; a successful idempotency classification can then mask different serialized evidence.
guardrail: At the vault validation boundary accept only ordinary Object.prototype or null-prototype records and metrics. Reject other objects before hashing, fail closed for exotic nested objects, and regression-test Date metrics and inherited toJSON against the actual JSON serialization boundary.
